paragraphs: This policy applies to every team handling {client} information at the {city} site.
Information is classified as public, internal, confidential, or restricted according to the impact of improper disclosure.
Access follows least privilege and is reviewed every quarter.
Access requests are recorded under {id} and approved by the area owner.
Digital records are retained for seven years unless a different legal period applies.
Disposal requires dual confirmation and produces an immutable audit record.
Backups are verified monthly through a restore test.
Any incident must be reported to the internal contact within twenty-four hours.
Annual training is mandatory for everyone with access to critical systems.
Error code {error_code} identifies an expired access request in the ticket system.
External suppliers are bound by the same confidentiality obligations.
This standard is reviewed annually or after a material risk change.
Exceptions must be documented, justified, and approved by the responsible director.
list_items: Name an owner for every document repository.
Record access and reviews in one central system.
Encrypt removable media with organisation-managed keys.
Test continuity plans at least once a year.
Delete temporary copies after the final record is validated.
